messages.en:
{01 00 00 05 00}I know all about what you
did, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 15 00}I know you
opened my package.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}The thing is,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00} you're
the one that lost
something, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}I can buy another present.
It can be replaced.

{07 05 00}But my respect for you
is deader than a sad,
forgotten noodle.{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{01 00 00 05 00}Ma tean kõike, mida sa
tegid, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 15 00}Ma tean, et
sa avasid mu paki{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Asi on selles,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00} et sina
oled see, kes midagi
kaotas, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Ma võin osta uue kingituse.
Seda saab asendada.

{07 05 00}Aga mu austus sinu vastu
on surnum kui kurb,
unustatud nuudel.{03 02 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hey,{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 01 00} I know all about 
how you opened my package.

{07 05 00}I didn't think you were
capable of doing something 
as shady as that.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
But you'll be sorry if you
cross me again like that, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Kuule,{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 01 00} ma tean kõike
sellest, kuidas sa mu paki
avasid.
{07 05 00}Ma ei arvanud, et sa oled
võimeline midagi nii
hämarat tegema{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Aga sa kahetsed, kui mind
veel niimoodi alt tõmbad,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 02 00 01}
